label: Resident population
definition: Permanent resident population at year end (state the national definition in comparability_note)
notes: Denominator for all per-capita ratios; record one value per year

label: Surface area
definition: Total surface area; state in comparability_note whether lakes or reclaimed land are included
notes: Denominator for per-km2 ratios

label: Share of foreign residents
definition: Residents without the country's citizenship as share of residents

label: Net migration
definition: Arrivals minus departures in the year (international + domestic unless stated)
notes: State whether domestic moves are included

label: Resident millionaires
definition: Residents with USD 1m+ liquid investable wealth
notes: Henley & Partners definition; check geography used by Henley

label: Resident centi-millionaires
definition: Residents with USD 100m+ liquid investable wealth
notes: Henley & Partners definition

label: Total taxable net wealth of individuals
definition: Sum of declared taxable net wealth of natural persons
notes: Exists only where a wealth tax exists (Swiss cantons); not comparable abroad

label: Bank offices (head offices + branches)
definition: All domestic offices of licensed banks located in the territory
notes: Swiss source: SNB Geschäftsstellen; keep banks separate from branches

label: Banks headquartered
definition: Licensed banks with registered office in the territory

label: Licensed credit institutions
definition: Credit institutions authorised by the supervisor (includes foreign branches)
notes: Different definition from bank_offices: do not mix

label: Commercial bank branches per 100k adults
definition: As published by IMF Financial Access Survey (adults = 15+)
notes: Published ratio; national only; not the same as offices per 100k residents

label: Wealth and asset management firms
definition: Authorised wealth or asset managers
notes: Check licence type in comparability_note

label: Local establishments (workplaces)
definition: Local units of enterprises located in the territory
notes: BFS STATENT 'Arbeitsstätten'; not the same as registered companies

label: Registered companies
definition: Legal entities registered in the commercial register

label: Persons employed
definition: Persons employed in the territory (workplace-based unless stated)
notes: State workplace vs residence basis

label: Unemployment rate
definition: Registered or ILO unemployment rate (state which)
notes: Registered (SECO) and ILO rates are not comparable

label: Median gross monthly wage
definition: Median gross monthly wage full-time equivalent

label: WGI Rule of Law
definition: World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators estimate
notes: Identical for all Swiss cantons

label: WGI Political Stability
definition: World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators estimate
notes: Identical for all Swiss cantons

label: Recorded offences per 1000 residents
definition: Offences recorded by police (state the legal basis)
notes: Legal definitions differ by country: usually grade B across countries

label: PM2.5 annual mean
definition: Annual mean concentration of PM2.5
notes: State station type (urban background vs traffic)

label: Top marginal income tax rate
definition: Combined top marginal rate on employment income for the reference municipality
notes: Swiss: federal + cantonal + municipal for the reference municipality

label: Wealth tax rate
definition: Top marginal wealth tax rate for the reference municipality

label: Lump-sum taxation available
definition: Availability of expenditure-based / flat-tax regime for new residents
notes: Record minimum base or flat amount as a separate row if needed

label: Inheritance tax for direct descendants
definition: Tax rate on inheritance to children

label: Residential price per m2
definition: Average or median transaction price per m2 of residential property (state which)
notes: Asking prices and transaction prices are not comparable

label: Prime residential price per m2
definition: Price per m2 of prime/luxury residential property
notes: Usually from Knight Frank or UBS; state the source definition of prime

label: Hospital beds
definition: Hospital beds in the territory
notes: Normalise by population in the analysis

label: International schools
definition: Schools offering an international curriculum (IB or foreign national)
notes: State the list used

label: Gross domestic product
definition: Nominal GDP of the territory at current prices
notes: Per-capita value calculated in the analysis with population of the same year

label: GDP per inhabitant
definition: Nominal GDP per inhabitant at current prices, as published by the statistical office
notes: Published ratio; used as a cross-check of W1 (gdp_nominal ÷ population) where the total is not available in the same currency

label: Employment in financial and insurance activities
definition: Persons employed in NOGA/NACE section K (workplace-based)
notes: Share of total employment calculated in the analysis; state FTE vs headcount

label: New companies registered
definition: New legal entities entered in the commercial register in the year
notes: Registration rules differ by country

label: Employment rate 15-64
definition: Employed persons aged 15-64 as share of population aged 15-64 (ILO/LFS)
notes: Published ratio; residence-based

label: Sovereign credit rating
definition: Long-term foreign-currency issuer rating (state agency) converted to a notch number
notes: Lower notch number = better rating; identical for all Swiss cantons

label: Basel AML Index
definition: Basel Institute on Governance money-laundering risk score
notes: Not every jurisdiction covered every year

label: Cost-of-living index
definition: Composite cost-of-living index for the main city (state publisher and base city)
notes: Commercial indices; use one index and one edition for all destinations

label: Direct international destinations
definition: Number of international destinations served non-stop from the main airport of the destination
notes: Accessibility; state airport and season

label: Travel time to intercontinental hub
definition: Door-to-terminal time from the main centre to the nearest airport with intercontinental flights
notes: Accessibility; state origin, airport and mode (car or public transport)

label: Effective income tax, reference case
definition: Total income tax as share of income for the agreed reference taxpayer in the reference municipality
notes: Reference case to be agreed (proposal: single, CHF 1m taxable income)

label: Effective wealth tax, reference case
definition: Total wealth tax as share of net wealth for the agreed reference taxpayer in the reference municipality
notes: 0 where no wealth tax exists

label: Lump-sum or flat-tax minimum
definition: Minimum taxable base or flat annual amount of the regime for new residents
notes: State whether it is a taxable base (Swiss forfait) or a flat tax amount

label: Residence route for financially independent or investor applicants
definition: A residence permit route exists for non-EU/EFTA applicants based on wealth, investment or tax contribution
notes: Summarise conditions in comparability_note

label: Prime residential price change
definition: Annual change in prime residential prices
notes: Usually Knight Frank PIRI; main cities only

label: Restrictions on foreign buyers
definition: Legal restrictions on the purchase of residential property by non-resident foreigners
notes: yes = restrictions apply (e.g. Lex Koller); describe them in comparability_note

label: Net international migration
definition: International arrivals minus international departures in the year
notes: Excludes domestic or intercantonal moves, unlike net_migration

label: Practising physicians
definition: Physicians practising in the territory
notes: Practising, not licensed; normalise by population in the analysis

label: Life expectancy at birth
definition: Life expectancy at birth, both sexes

label: Universities in global rankings
definition: Universities within about 1 hour of the main centre in the agreed global ranking (proposal: QS top 500)
notes: State ranking, edition and distance used

label: Tertiary-educated population
definition: Population aged 25-64 with tertiary education
